name: TANKZ - A PRACTICE GAME
author: Waterstudios11
description: Tankz is as of this date my first real project I made on my own. Using Unity with Blender 3D I managed to create all my assets. Currently it is not finished, the AI is poor, and the UI is inconsistent. However, with all this being said I thought it was a great way to start off with game development. Plus, the graphics are amazing.
